scope: 6 newly recognized components, 6 fully supported cards. Prior supported programs and metadata unchanged.
source: Rainier English card text included verbatim per component; conversion input matched by stable card ID.

ruleReference.usedFor: General damage/Weakness order, Bench damage and attack effects, Energy units, KO checks and effect source timing. Card-specific text is retained below.

evidence.name: Miraculous Shine
evidence.textEn: Devolve each of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.
evidence.textZh: 从对手所有已经进化的宝可梦身上各移除1张「进化卡」使其退化。将被移除的卡牌放回对手的手牌。

evidence.name: Colorful Harmony
evidence.textEn: This attack does 50 damage for each type of Basic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
evidence.textZh: 造成自己所有宝可梦身上附着的基本能量的属性种类数量×50伤害。

evidence.name: Reversed Clock
evidence.textEn: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
evidence.textZh: 选择自己弃牌区中的宝可梦和基本能量合计最多3张，在给对手看过之后放回牌库并重洗牌库。

evidence.name: Bouncy Circle
evidence.textEn: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has a maximum HP of 30.
evidence.textZh: 造成自己最大HP为「30」的备战宝可梦数量×30伤害。
